courses.name: Course 1 · Social Foundations
courses.description: Introductions, names, origins, and courteous first conversations.

courses.name: Course 2 · Building Connection
courses.description: Contact information, compliments, invitations, and date planning.

courses.name: Course 3 · Curious Conversation
courses.description: Open questions, personality, values, and natural follow-up responses.

courses.name: Course 4 · Storytelling
courses.description: Past events, sequencing, details, reactions, and follow-up questions.

spanish.name: Introductions and first meetings
spanish.objective: Introduce yourself and keep a first conversation moving.
opiPrompts: Preséntate y explica de dónde eres.
Describe cómo conociste a una persona importante.
Conoce a un nuevo cliente y usa lenguaje formal.
Explica qué hace que una primera conversación sea buena.

phrases.english: What is your name?
phrases.responseEnglish: My name is Nicolás. Nice to meet you.
phrases.note: Use usted in a formal or professional first meeting.

phrases.english: Where are you from?
phrases.responseEnglish: I am from Atlanta, Georgia.
phrases.note: A natural follow-up after exchanging names.

phrases.english: What do you do for work?
phrases.response: Trabajo en tecnología y construyo aplicaciones.
phrases.responseEnglish: I work in technology and build applications.
phrases.note: Use this after some basic rapport.

phrases.english: It was a pleasure meeting you.
phrases.responseEnglish: Likewise. I hope to see you soon.
phrases.note: A warm way to close a first conversation.

spanish.name: Contact, compliments, and plans
spanish.objective: Move respectfully from conversation to exchanging contact information and making plans.
opiPrompts: Pide información de contacto con respeto.
Cuenta cómo planeaste una cita.
Invita a alguien a tomar café y acuerden una hora.
Explica la diferencia entre un cumplido respetuoso y uno incómodo.

phrases.english: I enjoy talking with you.
phrases.response: A mí también. La conversación fluye muy bien.
phrases.responseEnglish: Me too. The conversation flows very well.
phrases.note: A warm compliment focused on the interaction.

phrases.english: May I have your phone number?
phrases.transliteration: meh dahs too NOO-meh-roh deh teh-LEH-foh-noh
phrases.responseEnglish: Sure, I will write it down for you.
phrases.note: The formal version is softer for a professional contact.

informal.transliteration: meh dahs too NOO-meh-roh deh teh-LEH-foh-noh

formal.transliteration: poh-DREE-ah DAR-meh soo NOO-meh-roh deh teh-LEH-foh-noh

phrases.english: Would you like to have coffee this weekend?
phrases.target: ¿Quieres tomar un café este fin de semana?
phrases.transliteration: KYEH-rehs toh-MAR oon kah-FEH EHS-teh feen deh seh-MAH-nah
phrases.response: Sí, el sábado por la tarde me queda bien.
phrases.responseEnglish: Yes, Saturday afternoon works for me.
phrases.note: Specific enough to lead into actual planning.

informal.target: ¿Quieres tomar un café este fin de semana?
informal.transliteration: KYEH-rehs toh-MAR oon kah-FEH EHS-teh feen deh seh-MAH-nah

formal.target: ¿Le gustaría tomar un café este fin de semana?
formal.transliteration: leh goo-stah-REE-ah toh-MAR oon kah-FEH EHS-teh feen deh seh-MAH-nah

phrases.english: What time and place work best for you?
phrases.target: ¿Qué hora y lugar te convienen más?
phrases.transliteration: keh OH-rah ee loo-GAR teh kohn-BYEH-nehn mahs
phrases.response: A las seis en el café del centro.
phrases.responseEnglish: At six at the downtown café.
phrases.note: Use after the other person accepts an invitation.

informal.target: ¿Qué hora y lugar te convienen más?
informal.transliteration: keh OH-rah ee loo-GAR teh kohn-BYEH-nehn mahs

formal.target: ¿Qué hora y lugar le convienen más?
formal.transliteration: keh OH-rah ee loo-GAR leh kohn-BYEH-nehn mahs

spanish.name: Personality and deeper questions
spanish.objective: Ask open questions and respond with reasons and examples.
opiPrompts: Describe tu fin de semana ideal.
Cuenta cómo cambiaron tus prioridades.
Pregunta sobre los valores de otra persona.
Explica si la personalidad puede cambiar con el tiempo.

phrases.english: What does your ideal weekend look like?
phrases.target: ¿Cómo es tu fin de semana ideal?
phrases.transliteration: KOH-moh ehs too feen deh seh-MAH-nah ee-deh-AL
phrases.response: Me gusta descansar, cocinar y pasar tiempo con mi familia.
phrases.responseEnglish: I like to rest, cook, and spend time with my family.
phrases.note: An open personality question that invites detail.

informal.target: ¿Cómo es tu fin de semana ideal?
informal.transliteration: KOH-moh ehs too feen deh seh-MAH-nah ee-deh-AL

formal.target: ¿Cómo es su fin de semana ideal?
formal.transliteration: KOH-moh ehs soo feen deh seh-MAH-nah ee-deh-AL

phrases.english: What quality do you value most in a person?
phrases.target: ¿Qué cualidad valoras más en una persona?
phrases.transliteration: keh kwah-lee-DAHD bah-LOH-rahs mahs ehn OO-nah pehr-SOH-nah
phrases.response: Valoro la honestidad porque crea confianza.
phrases.responseEnglish: I value honesty because it creates trust.
phrases.note: Follow with “why?” to deepen the conversation.

informal.target: ¿Qué cualidad valoras más en una persona?
informal.transliteration: keh kwah-lee-DAHD bah-LOH-rahs mahs ehn OO-nah pehr-SOH-nah

formal.target: ¿Qué cualidad valora más en una persona?
formal.transliteration: keh kwah-lee-DAHD bah-LOH-rah mahs ehn OO-nah pehr-SOH-nah

phrases.english: What are you passionate about?
phrases.response: Me apasionan la tecnología, la música y aprender idiomas.
phrases.responseEnglish: I am passionate about technology, music, and learning languages.
phrases.note: A concise question with many possible follow-ups.

phrases.english: What is something people misunderstand about you?
phrases.target: ¿Qué es algo que la gente no entiende de ti?
phrases.transliteration: keh ehs AHL-goh keh lah HEHN-teh noh ehn-TYEHN-deh deh tee
phrases.response: A veces parezco serio, pero simplemente soy reservado.
phrases.responseEnglish: Sometimes I seem serious, but I am simply reserved.
phrases.note: Best used after trust has developed.

informal.target: ¿Qué es algo que la gente no entiende de ti?
informal.transliteration: keh ehs AHL-goh keh lah HEHN-teh noh ehn-TYEHN-deh deh tee

formal.target: ¿Qué es algo que la gente no entiende de usted?
formal.transliteration: keh ehs AHL-goh keh lah HEHN-teh noh ehn-TYEHN-deh deh oo-STEHD

spanish.name: Stories and follow-up questions
spanish.objective: Tell a structured story and invite the listener to react.
opiPrompts: Cuenta algo divertido que pasó esta semana.
Narra una experiencia que te cambió.
Cuenta una historia con un problema inesperado.
Defiende por qué las historias ayudan a conocer a una persona.

phrases.english: Let me tell you what happened yesterday.
phrases.target: Déjame contarte lo que pasó ayer.
phrases.transliteration: DEH-hah-meh kohn-TAR-teh loh keh pah-SOH ah-YEHR
phrases.responseEnglish: Of course, what happened?
phrases.note: Opening: establish that a story is beginning.

informal.target: Déjame contarte lo que pasó ayer.
informal.transliteration: DEH-hah-meh kohn-TAR-teh loh keh pah-SOH ah-YEHR

formal.target: Permítame contarle lo que pasó ayer.
formal.transliteration: pehr-MEE-tah-meh kohn-TAR-leh loh keh pah-SOH ah-YEHR

phrases.english: At first, everything seemed normal.
phrases.responseEnglish: And when did the situation change?
phrases.note: Sequence marker: beginning.

phrases.english: Then something unexpected happened.
phrases.responseEnglish: No way! What did you do?
phrases.note: Sequence marker: complication.

phrases.english: In the end, we laughed about it.
phrases.target: Al final, nos reímos de lo ocurrido.
phrases.transliteration: ahl fee-NAHL nohs reh-EE-mohs deh loh oh-koo-REE-doh
phrases.responseEnglish: I am glad it ended well.
phrases.note: Sequence marker: resolution.

arabic.name: Introductions and first meetings
arabic.objective: Introduce yourself in Syrian Arabic and recognize a formal MSA alternative.
opiPrompts: عرّف عن حالك واحكي من وين إنت.
احكي كيف تعرفت على شخص مهم.
قابل زبون جديد واستعمل لغة رسمية.
اشرح شو بيخلي أول حديث ناجح.

phrases.english: What is your name?
phrases.responseEnglish: My name is Nicolás. Nice to meet you.
phrases.note: Syrian informal versus formal MSA.

phrases.english: Where are you from?
phrases.responseEnglish: I am from Atlanta, Georgia.
phrases.note: Common Syrian word order.

phrases.english: What do you do for work?
phrases.responseEnglish: I work in technology and build applications.
phrases.note: Formal MSA uses a different structure.

phrases.english: It was a pleasure meeting you.
phrases.response: الشرف إلي، إن شاء الله منشوفك قريب.
phrases.responseEnglish: The pleasure is mine. Hopefully I will see you soon.
phrases.note: Works as a warm close; the final vowel can vary by gender.

arabic.name: Contact, compliments, and plans
arabic.objective: Exchange contact information and make respectful plans.
opiPrompts: اطلب معلومات التواصل باحترام.
احكي كيف رتبت موعد.
اعزم حدا عالقهوة واتفقوا عالوقت.
اشرح الفرق بين المجاملة اللطيفة والمزعجة.

phrases.english: I enjoy talking with you.
phrases.responseEnglish: Me too. Talking with you is comfortable.
phrases.note: A warm, conversation-focused compliment.

phrases.english: May I have your phone number?
phrases.responseEnglish: Of course, I will write it for you.
phrases.note: Ask once and accept the answer without pressure.

formal.target: هل يمكنني الحصول على رقم هاتفك؟
formal.transliteration: hal yumkinunī al-ḥuṣūlu ʿalā raqami hātifik?

phrases.english: Would you like to have coffee this weekend?
phrases.responseEnglish: Yes, Saturday afternoon works for me.
phrases.note: A clear, low-pressure invitation.

formal.target: هل ترغب في تناول القهوة في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع؟
formal.transliteration: hal targhabu fī tanāwuli al-qahwati fī ʿuṭlati nihāyati al-usbūʿ?

phrases.english: What time and place work best for you?
phrases.response: الساعة ستة بالقهوة اللي بنص البلد.
phrases.responseEnglish: At six at the café downtown.
phrases.note: Use to turn an invitation into a plan.

arabic.name: Personality and deeper questions
arabic.objective: Ask thoughtful questions and support responses with reasons.
opiPrompts: اوصف عطلة نهاية الأسبوع المثالية إلك.
احكي كيف تغيرت أولوياتك.
اسأل شخص عن القيم المهمة عنده.
اشرح إذا الشخصية ممكن تتغير مع الوقت.

phrases.english: What does your ideal weekend look like?
phrases.target: كيف بتكون عطلة نهاية الأسبوع المثالية إلك؟
phrases.transliteration: kīf btikūn ʿuṭlit nihāyet il-usbūʿ il-mithāliyye elak?
phrases.response: بحب ارتاح واطبخ واقضي وقت مع عيلتي.
phrases.responseEnglish: I like to rest, cook, and spend time with my family.
phrases.note: An open question that invites detail.

informal.target: كيف بتكون عطلة نهاية الأسبوع المثالية إلك؟
informal.transliteration: kīf btikūn ʿuṭlit nihāyet il-usbūʿ il-mithāliyye elak?

formal.target: كيف تبدو عطلة نهاية الأسبوع المثالية لك؟
formal.transliteration: kayfa tabdū ʿuṭlatu nihāyati al-usbūʿi al-mithāliyatu lak?

phrases.english: What quality do you value most in a person?
phrases.responseEnglish: I value honesty because it builds trust.
phrases.note: Follow with why or an example.

formal.target: ما الصفة التي تقدّرها أكثر في الشخص؟
formal.transliteration: mā aṣ-ṣifatu allatī tuqaddiruhā akthara fī ash-shakhṣ?

phrases.english: What are you passionate about?
phrases.target: شو الشي اللي عندك شغف فيه؟
phrases.transliteration: shū ish-shī illi ʿindak shaghaf fīh?
phrases.response: عندي شغف بالتكنولوجيا والموسيقى وتعلّم اللغات.
phrases.responseEnglish: I am passionate about technology, music, and learning languages.
phrases.note: A natural invitation to talk about interests.

informal.target: شو الشي اللي عندك شغف فيه؟
informal.transliteration: shū ish-shī illi ʿindak shaghaf fīh?

phrases.english: What is something people misunderstand about you?
phrases.target: شو شغلة الناس بيفهموها غلط عنك؟
phrases.transliteration: shū shaghle in-nās byifhamuha ghalaṭ ʿannak?
phrases.response: أوقات ببين جدي، بس أنا بس شخص كتوم.
phrases.responseEnglish: Sometimes I seem serious, but I am simply reserved.
phrases.note: Better after some trust has developed.

informal.target: شو شغلة الناس بيفهموها غلط عنك؟
informal.transliteration: shū shaghle in-nās byifhamuha ghalaṭ ʿannak?

formal.target: ما الأمر الذي يسيء الناس فهمه عنك؟
formal.transliteration: mā al-amru alladhī yusīʾu an-nāsu fahmahu ʿank?

arabic.name: Stories and follow-up questions
arabic.objective: Tell a story with a beginning, complication, and resolution.
opiPrompts: احكي شي مضحك صار معك هالأسبوع.
احكي عن تجربة غيرتك.
احكي قصة صار فيها مشكلة مو متوقعة.
اشرح ليش القصص بتساعدنا نعرف الشخص.

phrases.english: Let me tell you what happened yesterday.
phrases.responseEnglish: Of course, what happened?
phrases.note: Opening: establish that a story is beginning.

phrases.english: At first, everything seemed normal.
phrases.responseEnglish: And when did the situation change?
phrases.note: Sequence marker: beginning.

formal.target: في البداية، بدا كل شيء طبيعياً.
formal.transliteration: fī al-bidāyati, badā kullu shayʾin ṭabīʿiyyan.

phrases.english: Then something unexpected happened.
phrases.target: بعدين صار شي ما كان عالبال.
phrases.transliteration: baʿdēn ṣār shī mā kān ʿal-bāl.
phrases.responseEnglish: Really? What did you do?
phrases.note: Sequence marker: complication.

informal.target: بعدين صار شي ما كان عالبال.
informal.transliteration: baʿdēn ṣār shī mā kān ʿal-bāl.

phrases.english: In the end, we laughed about it.
phrases.responseEnglish: It is good that it ended well.
phrases.note: Sequence marker: resolution.

formal.target: في النهاية، ضحكنا بشأن ما حدث.
formal.transliteration: fī an-nihāyati, ḍaḥiknā bishaʾni mā ḥadath.
